title: Crosscheck aircraft profile
description: One file per aircraft. Structure, types and allowed keys are checked here. Class rules (pulse needs pulse_ms, verified needs values or range, ...) and cross references are checked by the Crosscheck.Profiles validator, see profiles/SCHEMA.md.

format.description: Profile format version. The bridge refuses versions it does not know.

groups.description: Panel groups. Used for snapshot hashing and control ownership.

exclude.description: Glob patterns (* and ?) for scanned vars that do not belong to the aircraft at all.

datarefs.description: Fenix GraphQL datarefs. Fenix cannot list them, so each one is written down by hand.

group_labels.description: Names of the panel groups as the pilots see them, for example mip: Main panel.

match.description: How the bridge recognises the loaded aircraft. At least one of titles / packages.

titles.description: Globs against the aircraft title the sim reports.

builds.description: Aircraft builds this profile was made and tested for.

verify.description: Where the effect of a write is checked. Exactly one of lvar / mcdu / graphql.

lvar.description: Another var in this profile that shows the effect.

mcdu.description: 1 or 2. The screen hash of this CDU must be equal on both sims after settle_ms.

graphql.description: A dataref path. Polled over HTTP and compared between the sims.

expect.description: same: value equals the other sim's value after settle (default). parity: only odd/even is compared (press counters).

scale.description: Factor between the written value and what this source shows, for example 1024 for analog knobs in GraphQL.

contains.description: mcdu only, for local tests only: the screen must contain this text. Never used in a session.

range.description: Allowed [min, max] (verified, analog). Hard write limit.

pulse_ms.description: pulse with press momentary: time between writing 1 and writing 0. Not used with press edge.

press.description: pulse: momentary (default) = write 1, then 0 after pulse_ms. edge = Fenix counts press and release (odd = down); each down and up edge is mirrored as it happens.

display.description: delta: the var that shows the value the encoder changes.

rate_hz.description: stream: send rate from the PF.

rest.description: verified, spring-loaded switches only: the position the switch returns to by itself (one of values). If the release of a position Crosscheck wrote never arrives (30 s cap, link lost), Crosscheck writes this value back, with a red desync (protocol.md section 5).

alarm.description: observe only: this indicator shows a pilot input Crosscheck cannot sync (yet). A difference between the sims is red after 2 s, never quiet, with this text. Never written.

as.description: Report it under this control, so several indicators of one knob give one line.

label.description: Name as the pilots see it, for example ENG 1 BLEED.

value_labels.description: Names of values as the pilots see them, for example { "0": OFF, "1": ON }.

roles.description: Vars with a special meaning for Crosscheck beyond being synced. Each one must also be listed in 'vars'.

takeover.description: Sidestick takeover pushbutton per seat. A press on the pilot monitoring's own seat is a control request; the press itself is synced like any other var.

label.description: Name as the pilots see it, for example Fuel left.

unit.description: Unit of the value, for example kg. Shown with drift.

drift_warn.description: owned only: a difference larger than this (in unit) shows one amber line.

drift_step.description: owned only: a change of the difference smaller than this (in unit) is sent at most every 10 s. Default: half of drift_warn.
